notes.title: Better！
notes.content:
Dear players, thank you for your support of our game. In this update, we have fixed and updated some functions to make you more enjoyable in the game!

1. Fixed the face problem of custom characters! Now you can create the most realistic avatar!
2. Fixed bugs in wallpaper mode, now the experience is smoother.
3. When the avatar generation fails, the game will automatically change the connection settings.
4. Fixed bugs reported by players.

Thank you for your support and feedback, we will continue to update and optimize the game content to bring you a better gaming experience! Don't forget to share this update with your Steam friends!
